content.user_title: Manage CAPA Investigations and Action Plans
content.value_statement: CAPA teams need consistent investigations, root cause analysis, action planning, and verification records. This skill guides structured CAPA workflows, documentation, metrics, and regulatory alignment.
actual_capabilities: Guide CAPA lifecycle steps from initiation through effectiveness verification.
Recommend root cause methods including 5 Why, fishbone, fault tree, human factors analysis, and FMEA.
Outline immediate, corrective, preventive, and verification action plan components.
Define CAPA metrics such as cycle time, recurrence rate, overdue rate, and investigation quality.
Connect CAPA work with management review, audits, document control, training, supplier quality, and regulatory expectations.
limitations: It does not replace formal quality, regulatory, legal, or medical device compliance review.
The included script, asset, and reference files are placeholders and do not provide working automation.
It cannot verify CAPA effectiveness without user-provided evidence, records, and performance data.
It provides process guidance, not binding interpretation of FDA, ISO, or EU MDR requirements.

use_cases.title: Standardize CAPA Intake and Closure
use_cases.description: Create a consistent workflow for documenting events, assessing significance, assigning actions, and closing CAPAs with evidence.

use_cases.title: Select Root Cause Methods
use_cases.description: Choose a fitting investigation approach for quality issues, safety events, process deviations, or recurring nonconformances.

use_cases.title: Prepare CAPA Performance Reviews
use_cases.description: Summarize cycle time, recurrence, overdue actions, investigation quality, and effectiveness results for leadership review.

prompt_templates.title: Start a CAPA Investigation
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a new CAPA record.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me structure a CAPA investigation for this event: [describe event]. Include scope, impact, containment, required evidence, and next questions.

prompt_templates.title: Choose an RCA Method
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this problem statement and recommend the best root cause analysis method. Explain why and outline the investigation steps: [problem statement].

prompt_templates.title: Build a CAPA Action Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for corrective and preventive actions.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a CAPA action plan from these confirmed causes: [causes]. Include immediate actions, corrective actions, preventive actions, owners, due dates, and verification criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Audit CAPA System Performance
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these CAPA metrics and trends: [metrics]. Identify systemic risks, weak controls, overdue patterns, recurrence signals, and management review recommendations.

output_examples.input: A complaint trend shows repeat labeling errors across two product lines.
output: Recommended RCA method: fishbone analysis supported by process mapping.
Key evidence: complaint records, label change history, training records, and batch review notes.
Suggested actions: contain affected lots, update label verification steps, retrain operators, and verify recurrence reduction.

output_examples.input: A CAPA is overdue and the corrective action has not reduced recurrence.
output: Escalate the CAPA for management review and reassess root cause validity.
Check whether actions addressed symptoms instead of system causes.
Define new effectiveness measures with clear data sources and review dates.

output_examples.input: Leadership needs a quarterly CAPA status summary.
output: Report open, closed, overdue, and escalated CAPAs with cycle time trends.
Highlight repeat causes, high-risk areas, and preventive action opportunities.
Include decisions needed from leadership and owners for overdue commitments.

best_practices: Provide event details, affected process, risk level, dates, and available evidence before asking for CAPA guidance.
Separate containment, root cause correction, preventive action, and effectiveness verification in every plan.
Review outputs with qualified quality and regulatory staff before using them in controlled records.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill to close a CAPA without objective effectiveness evidence.
Do not treat generated wording as approved regulatory language without internal review.
Do not skip root cause validation because a corrective action seems obvious.

faq.question: What is this skill for?
faq.answer: It supports CAPA investigation planning, root cause analysis, action planning, metrics review, and effectiveness verification.

faq.question: Does it replace a quality professional?
faq.answer: No. It provides structured guidance that qualified quality, regulatory, or compliance staff should review.

faq.question: Can it create regulatory-ready CAPA records?
faq.answer: It can draft structured content, but your organization must verify evidence, approvals, and controlled document requirements.

faq.question: Which RCA methods does it cover?
faq.answer: It references 5 Why, fishbone diagrams, fault tree analysis, human factors analysis, and FMEA.

faq.question: Can it analyze CAPA metrics?
faq.answer: Yes. It can help review cycle time, recurrence, overdue actions, first-time effectiveness, and investigation quality.

faq.question: Are the included scripts functional?
faq.answer: No. The bundled script, reference, and asset files are placeholders in this package.
